fundamental.summary: SPG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 91 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 buy, 2 sells) with no composite signal; market fear (44 score) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (274.6) indicates extreme market stress, and real estate sector faces structural headwinds from rising rates; earnings in 91 days adds event risk but not imminent.
